# DentaSmart

DentaSmart is a consumer AI oral health product that helps people upload mouth photos or dental X-rays, get AI-powered oral health insights, receive an Oral Health Score, understand findings in plain English, compare treatment plans, avoid surprise dental costs, and prepare for better conversations with a licensed dentist.

## Core Positioning

DentaSmart is Your Personal AI Dentist in Your Pocket.

For compliance-sensitive contexts, DentaSmart can also be described as an AI Oral Health Guide.

## What DentaSmart Does

- Analyzes mouth photos and dental X-rays
- Provides an Oral Health Score from 0 to 100
- Explains possible oral health concerns in plain English
- Helps users compare treatment plans
- Helps users understand possible costs before committing
- Provides Din, a 24/7 AI Guide for oral health questions
- Supports second opinions
- Supports family profiles and oral health monitoring
- Benefits membership with discounted dental network and BNPL is coming soon

## Current Pricing

Use the live pricing page as the source of truth:
https://dentasmart.ai/pricing

Known public pricing:
- Individual Insights: $75/year
- Family Insights: $150/year
- Second Opinion: $30 one-time
- Benefits: coming soon, with discounted dental network, 20-60% savings, and BNPL options

## Important Notes

- DentaSmart provides AI-powered oral health insights and education.
- DentaSmart helps users prepare for better dentist conversations.
- DentaSmart does not replace a licensed dentist for diagnosis or treatment.
- Emergency symptoms should be handled by a licensed dentist, urgent care, or emergency services.
